node.title: how to grep from a log file
node.author: noviceuser
node.doctext:
I am trying to grep FAIL from a log file and sending mail in case there is any occurence of FAIL in the log, but i am getting below syntax error. Please help

Reason - syntax error at ./aakash_script.pl line 21, near "'FAIL' $logFile"

my $status = 0; my $logFile = "/icd/rc/genus22/logs/genus_221/v22.10-d037/lnx86_64_opt/1/tamper.log"; if (-e $logFile) { $status = grep ': FAIL' $logFile; sendMail("kaakash", "Check Tamper Test failed", "Check tamper test failed.", "xyz") if ($status != 0); $status ++ ; } else { $status ++; sendMail("kaakash", "Check Tamper Test failed:", "$logFile not found.", "xyz"); }
